title: Starting Points & Occasions: を皮切りに, を機に, を限りに, を経て, てからというもの, にあって, 折に
description: Starting with, taking the opportunity of, as of (the last time), by way of, ever since, in the midst of, and on the occasion of.

points.title: 〜を皮切りに: starting with
points.summary: Noun + を皮切りに = A was the first in a series that followed.
points.body: - 東京公演**を皮切りに**、全国ツアーが始まった.
examples: {東京|とうきょう}{公演|こうえん}を{皮切|かわき}りに、{全国|ぜんこく}ツアーが{始|はじ}まった。
Starting with the Tokyo show, the national tour began.

points.title: 〜を機に: taking the opportunity of
points.summary: Noun + を機に = with A as the turning point (機 = opportunity).
points.body: - 就職**を機に**、一人暮らしを始めた.
examples: {病気|びょうき}を{機|き}に、{酒|さけ}をやめた。
My illness was the turning point — I quit drinking.

points.title: 〜を限りに: as of (… no more)
points.summary: Time noun + を限りに = from then on, something ends.
points.body: - 今日**を限りに**、たばこをやめます.
examples: {本日|ほんじつ}を{限|かぎ}りに、{当店|とうてん}は{閉店|へいてん}いたします。
As of today, this shop is closing.

points.title: 〜を経て: via, after going through
points.summary: Noun + を経て = by way of a place, or after a process.
points.body:
- 長い議論**を経て**、結論が出た.
- 香港**を経て**バンコクへ行く.
examples: {長|なが}い{議論|ぎろん}を{経|へ}て、ようやく{結論|けつろん}が{出|で}た。
After a long debate, a conclusion was finally reached.

points.title: 〜てからというもの: ever since
points.summary: て-form + からというもの = since A, things have changed completely.
points.body: - 子供が生まれて**からというもの**、生活が一変した.
examples: {彼女|かのじょ}に{出会|であ}ってからというもの、{毎日|まいにち}が{楽|たの}しい。
Ever since I met her, every day has been fun.

points.title: 〜にあって: in (a situation)
points.summary: Noun + にあって = being in that (special) situation.
points.body: - 厳しい状況**にあって**、彼は冷静さを失わなかった.
examples: {異国|いこく}の{地|ち}にあって、{家族|かぞく}の{大切|たいせつ}さを{知|し}った。
Being in a foreign land, I learned how precious family is.

points.title: 〜折(に): on the occasion
points.summary: Plain form / noun + の + 折(に / には) = when (a good occasion), polite.
points.body: - 京都へお越しの**折には**、ぜひお立ち寄りください.
examples: {上京|じょうきょう}した{折|おり}に、{恩師|おんし}を{訪|たず}ねた。
When I went up to Tokyo, I visited my old teacher.

questions.prompt: {東京公演|とうきょうこうえん}（　）、{全国|ぜんこく}ツアーが{始|はじ}まった。
notes: を経て = 'via' — it's the start of the tour, not a stop.
questions.translation: Starting with the Tokyo show, the national tour began.

questions.prompt: その{発言|はつげん}（　）、{次々|つぎつぎ}と{反対意見|はんたいいけん}が{出|で}た。
notes: をもって = 'by means of / as of'.
questions.translation: That remark set off a string of objections.

questions.prompt: {就職|しゅうしょく}（　）、{一人暮|ひとりぐ}らしを{始|はじ}めた。
notes: 気 = 'mind' (気にする = worry) — same sound.
questions.translation: When I started work, I took the chance to start living on my own.

questions.prompt: What does 「{病気|びょうき}を{機|き}に、{酒|さけ}をやめた。」 mean?
options: My illness was the turning point — I quit drinking.
I got ill after I quit drinking.
I quit drinking during my illness, then started again.
I quit drinking because I was worried I'd get ill.
notes: That would be 病気を気にして.

questions.prompt: {今日|きょう}（　）、たばこをやめます。
questions.translation: As of today, I'm quitting smoking.

questions.prompt: {本日|ほんじつ}（　）、{当店|とうてん}は{閉店|へいてん}いたします。{長|なが}い{間|あいだ}ありがとうございました。
notes: を機に = 'as a turning point' — today isn't the cause.
questions.translation: As of today, this shop is closing. Thank you for all these years.

questions.prompt: {長|なが}い{議論|ぎろん}（　）、ようやく{結論|けつろん}が{出|で}た。
notes: を皮切りに = the first of a series — a debate isn't the start of several conclusions.
questions.translation: After a long debate, a conclusion was finally reached.

questions.prompt: この{飛行機|ひこうき}は{香港|ホンコン}（　）バンコクへ{行|い}く。
notes: 経る can't link to 行く like this.
経って isn't a form of 経る.
questions.translation: This plane goes to Bangkok via Hong Kong.

questions.prompt: {子供|こども}が{生|う}まれて（　）、{生活|せいかつ}が{一変|いっぺん}した。
questions.explanation: Ever since: **てからというもの**.
questions.translation: Ever since our child was born, life has changed completely.

questions.prompt: What does 「{彼女|かのじょ}に{出会|であ}ってからというもの、{毎日|まいにち}が{楽|たの}しい。」 mean?
options: Ever since I met her, every day has been fun.
Before I met her, every day was fun.
After meeting her once, I had fun that day.
Just because I met her doesn't mean every day is fun.
questions.explanation: てからというもの = **ever since (lasting change)**.

questions.prompt: {厳|きび}しい{状況|じょうきょう}（　）、{彼|かれ}は{冷静|れいせい}さを{失|うしな}わなかった。
questions.translation: Even in a tough situation, he kept his cool.

questions.prompt: What does 「{異国|いこく}の{地|ち}にあって、{家族|かぞく}の{大切|たいせつ}さを{知|し}った。」 mean?
options: I went abroad to meet my family.
Being in a foreign land, I learned how precious family is.
I learned about my family's land abroad.
My family taught me about foreign countries.

questions.prompt: {今度|こんど}{京都|きょうと}へお{越|こ}しの（　）、ぜひお{立|た}ち{寄|よ}りください。
notes: 折から = 'just then / since it's the season of' — not 'when you come'.
questions.translation: Next time you come to Kyoto, please do drop by.

questions.prompt: What does 「{上京|じょうきょう}した{折|おり}に、{恩師|おんし}を{訪|たず}ねた。」 mean?
options: I visited Tokyo to look for a teacher.
My teacher folded up and went to Tokyo.
I left Tokyo after visiting my teacher.
When I went up to Tokyo, I visited my old teacher.
notes: 上京 = going to the capital.
